min_stay.season: Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day weekends (2027 rule)

values.note: Cedar Point, Eagle Ridge, Hickory Hollow, Woodland Hills, Walnut Grove and Sunset Ridge reserve site-specific on Kansas's ReserveAmerica site (campitks.gov); KDWP lists Prairie View and Rusty Windmill as not reservable (campitks still lists their sites), so those are first come, first served. 2027 holiday minimum: 3 nights over Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends. Up to 14 consecutive nights in one campground, then move to another campground in the park. 31 sites are marked long-term.

booking.source: https://www.campitks.gov/camping/milford-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.page?parkID=519127 ('2027 CAMPSITES Holiday Minimum Stay Rule'; '14 days maximum consecutive stay rule'; campsiteDetails 'Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific', 'Long Term Site: Y' on 31) and https://www.ksoutdoors.gov/about-kdwp/where-we-work/state-parks/milford (Prairie View and Rusty Windmill 'Reservable Sites: No'; the other campgrounds 'Reservable Sites: Yes'), read 2026-11-06

values.note: Full hookups at Eagle Ridge (21), Hickory Hollow (29), Rusty Windmill (2) and one site each at Woodland Hills and Sunset Ridge; water and electric at Cedar Point (34), Woodland Hills (29) and Prairie View (20); all 50/30/20 A. KDWP counts 60 three-utility and 91 two-utility sites.

values.note: Utility sites run 30-75 ft (Eagle Ridge all 75 ft; Cedar Point asphalt pads 40-74 ft); the 98-ft sites are primitive (Woodland Hills, Walnut Grove). Pull-throughs at Woodland Hills, Hickory Hollow, Prairie View, Sunset Ridge, Cedar Point and Walnut Grove.

note: On the southeast shore of Milford Reservoir, Kansas's largest lake. The campgrounds sit in two clusters about 2 km apart on the park road: Woodland Hills (the pin), Hickory Hollow, Walnut Grove and Cedar Point (a marina peninsula whose west-row sites sit just above the water) to the north; Eagle Ridge, Prairie View (on a cove), Sunset Ridge and Rusty Windmill to the south. Cabins and equestrian camping too. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on campitks.gov + KDWP: year-round, 50 A full hookups and W/E, holiday 3-night 2027 minimum, 14-night max; Prairie View/Rusty Windmill FCFS per KDWP; added sites, facilities, booking url; fees left as stored (KDWP schedule); note rewritten without counts.
flags: Website: replace https://www.reserveamerica.com/explore/milford-state-park/KS/519127/overview with https://www.campitks.gov/camping/milford-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.page?parkID=519127 (keep https://www.ksoutdoors.gov/about-kdwp/where-we-work/state-parks/milford). apply.py doesn't write website.

Waterfront (stored lakeview): the pin (Woodland Hills, 39.1163,-96.8935, = that loop's centroid) is ~250-300 m from the lake behind woods; no water view from those sites, so lakeview is generous for the pin itself. But Cedar Point's west-row sites (420-433, asphalt pads on a peninsula, ~39.1138,-96.9006) sit 10-20 m above riprap with open grass between pads and water, and Prairie View 109-116 (~39.0958,-96.9005) are 15-25 m from a cove across open mown ground: both lakefront by the open-apron rule (Esri imagery with campitks site GIS coordinates). Eagle Ridge (~150 m+ from water through trees), Hickory Hollow, Walnut Grove no. Keep lakeview as a whole-park value, or lakefront if AWH prefers to repin at Cedar Point. campitks marks 'River/Lake View: Y' on Cedar Point 34, Woodland Hills 22, Eagle Ridge 21, Prairie View 20, Walnut Grove 18 and Sunset Ridge 10 sites (an operator claim; for Woodland Hills/Eagle Ridge imagery shows only possible filtered glimpses).

Split candidate (judgement): the south cluster (Eagle Ridge 21 full hookup, Prairie View 20 W/E, Sunset Ridge, Rusty Windmill; ~39.098,-96.905) is ~2.2-2.5 km from the pin cluster and has its own branch of the park road, but both are reached through the same park road network off K-57 (one park entrance per campitks directions 'after crossing the dam, take the second left to the state park entrance'), so not a clear own-entrance split. Cedar Point is ~700 m from the pin.
Counts: KDWP says 8 campgrounds, 60 three-utility + 91 two-utility + 103 primitive (254); campitks's catalog lists 137 utility + 102 primitive campsites. sites.count not written (brief: NO count).
